entries.en: to reproach (a person) to his face, to cast (a fault) in one's teeth (dar en rostro)
entries.notes: 西语 dar en rostro 为当面责难，与汉字“施”（施予/施行）义不相合，四栏未能互证。

entries.en: to sell, to give over (goods) in trade; (dar desgracia) to disfavor, to bring misfortune
entries.notes: 汉字“售”与 desgracia 语义不合，疑本条取 dar 在马尼拉贸易中“出让、售出”之义。

entries.en: to give thanks; to decline or refuse politely
entries.notes: M 栏 cong cun 未能辨义，仅“謝 siā”可读，且与 desgracia 不合。

entries.en: to disfavor, to bring (someone) misfortune (dar desgracia)
entries.notes: H“迪”与 M sio 对音不合，又与 desgracia 语义无法衔接，四栏不能互证。

entries.en: to turn round, to go about in circles; to give back, to return (something)
entries.notes: M 栏 ox/or 不明（疑为“與/予”之残），据“還”本义定夺。

entries.zh: 领取，领受（領）；赊取，先取货后偿价
entries.en: to give on credit, to trust (goods) on credit (dar fiado)
entries.notes: R 栏 leng/keng 存疑；“領”为受方，与西语“赊出”为同一赊账行为之两面。

entries.en: to put (someone) to shame to his face; to make (him) stand in awe (dar en rostro)
entries.notes: L 栏 enostros/enfiados 讹误难解，与“畏”不能互证，释义仅据汉字与 M 栏。

entries.en: to trip (someone) up, to make (him) fall headlong (cancadilla/zancadilla)
entries.notes: L 栏 cancadilla 存疑，然 M siēn tò（顛倒/摔倒）与“顛”互证，语义可定。

entries.zh: 给予，发给；发放薪饷、口粮（M 栏注 Salario）
entries.en: to give out, to hand over; (a superior) to give wages or provisions
entries.notes: L 栏 resibio difensio. e. 残缺难解，仅“給”与 Salario 可据，全条存疑。

entries.zh: 赐予，赏赐（上对下的给予）
entries.en: to bestow, to grant (as a superior to an inferior)
to confer, to bestow formally (as a ruler grants)

entries.zh: 拍打，拍击（持扇拍打、挥扇）
entries.en: to strike (someone) with the fan held in the hand; to fan
entries.notes: L 栏 abanico/abaniure 存疑；“拍 pèg（phah）”与“打”义合。

entries.en: to receive (a favor), to be favored; (dar gracias) to give thanks for a favor received
entries.notes: R 栏〔残〕ông，据 H“蒙”与 M bong 定夺。

entries.zh: 道谢，致谢（“谢感你”即表谢意）
entries.en: to give thanks, to thank (someone)
entries.notes: M 栏 cam nia 疑读 kám-lí（感你），原件有〔疑〕。

entries.en: to give many thanks, to thank (someone) very much

entries.zh: 布散，分发；布施（分与食物）
entries.en: to distribute, to give out (one's food)

entries.zh: 布置，摆布，安排（把食物摆开分派）
entries.en: to set out, to arrange, to dispose (food) for distribution
entries.notes: 西语 repartiendo 重在分派，汉字“布置”重在摆列，义域相近而不等同。

entries.en: to garrote, to strangle (judicial execution by garrote)
to execute by garrote; the penalty of death by strangling
entries.notes: R 栏首音节 giân 与“絞（jiǎo）”对音不合，其余三栏一致。

entries.en: to turn round like a wheel, to revolve
to give credit to, to believe; credit, good faith
entries.notes: H 栏誠/誌存疑，据 M sēng（誠）定夺；dar crédito 从“相信”义。

entries.en: to congratulate, to give one's congratulations (dar el parabién)
entries.notes: L 栏 el para bien 即 parabién；M 栏污损，H/R（慶賀、guēng hō）一致。
